workspace.description: Path to the directory where recon-ng stores workspaces and databases. Corresponds to the -w workspace CLI argument.

resource_file.description: Path to a resource file containing commands to be loaded and executed on startup. Corresponds to the -r filename CLI argument. Empty string means no resource file is loaded.

no_version.description: If true, disables the version check on startup. Corresponds to the --no-version CLI argument.

no_analytics.description: If true, disables analytics reporting. Corresponds to the --no-analytics CLI argument.

no_marketplace.description: If true, disables remote module management from the marketplace. Corresponds to the --no-marketplace CLI argument.

stealth.description: If true, enables stealth mode which disables all passive requests. Corresponds to the --stealth CLI argument.

analytics.description: If true, enables Google analytics reporting. Corresponds to the --analytics CLI argument.
